newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB phone banking up 300 pct in year.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB phone banking up 300 pct in year.

text.p: Australia's largest bank, The National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), said on Wednesday the number of customers using its telephone banking service had increased by more than 300 percent in the last year.
NAB said the number of calls handled over the same period increased by 280 percent.

Australia's largest banks have stressed in recent years the need to reduce the size of their branch networks, among the world's largest on a per-capita basis, and increase the use of telephone and computer banking.
